sentences.name: unit_taper_array_spine
sentences.rationale: Full-unit long-axis bar tapered along its length and arrayed to create a rhythmic street front on the east. Upper floors narrow toward the north setback edge, managing the sunlight slope without stepping the section explicitly.

sentences.name: unit_split_join_east_bar
sentences.rationale: Long-axis full unit split longitudinally then rejoined with a lateral offset, producing a Z-section plan that keeps GFA while articulating the east public face against the road.

sentences.name: unit_branch_pack_stack_la
sentences.rationale: Full-unit long-axis figure branches and packs subsidiary volumes then stacks them, expressing a hierarchical east-facing public office cluster at 5 storeys with the south face open.

sentences.name: unit_skew_reflect_pack_la
sentences.rationale: Full-unit long-axis form skewed in plan then reflected and packed, creating a mirrored oblique twin that opens a shared lobby gap on the east entry and tucks the north volume away from the sunlight plane.

sentences.name: unit_bend_stack_la
sentences.rationale: Full-unit long-axis bar bent mid-section and stacked to form a stepped L-bend in section, with the taller arm east and the bent lower cap retreating north, responding to the 9-m sunlight setback slope.

sentences.name: unit_branch_la_v2
sentences.rationale: Simple branch from a full-unit long-axis seed sends one arm east to the road and one arm south, forming a Y in plan visible from the public street while keeping the north side clear.

sentences.name: unit_extrude_la
sentences.rationale: Straightforward extrusion of the full-unit long-axis profile to 5 storeys; the east face aligns with the road, maximum coverage within BCR, reference datum for the batch.

sentences.name: unit_intersect_la
sentences.rationale: Two full-unit long-axis volumes intersected to subtract the overlap, yielding a cross-shaped void at the junction. 4 storeys keeps the smaller residual footprint within ground coverage.

sentences.name: unit_offset_la
sentences.rationale: Full-unit long-axis form with an outward offset on the east skin, thickening the public facade zone while keeping the structural volume within parcel. The offset is a GFA donor on the entry side.

sentences.name: unit_shift_la
sentences.rationale: Upper floors shifted west relative to the ground slab, creating a cantilevered east canopy entry and a tiered north profile that complies with the sunlight setback by retreating higher.

sentences.name: unit_embed_branch_la
sentences.rationale: Case 61: secondary volume embedded inside the primary full-unit long-axis bar, then a branch extends east as a public porch. The embed creates a central atrium pocket; the branch marks the entrance.

sentences.name: unit_expand_nest_la
sentences.rationale: Case 63: outer shell expanded while an inner form is nested inside, reading as a double-skin public building; south facing keeps sunlight available through the outer layer.

sentences.name: unit_bend_shift_la
sentences.rationale: Case 65: curved deformation combined with a lateral shift creates a C-plan open to the west interior; east facade remains straight for public legibility facing the road.

sentences.name: unit_lift_carve_la
sentences.rationale: Case 67: ground slab lifted on the south side and the remaining solid carved, forming a pilotis passage on the south with a carved entrance recess on the east public face.

sentences.name: unit_overlap_rotate_la
sentences.rationale: Case 69: two overlapping volumes rotated against each other in plan; the overlap zone becomes the shared core. Lower GFA target reduces massing at the north edge.

sentences.name: unit_embed_embed_la
sentences.rationale: Combination 04: double embed produces a concentric section with two distinct occupancy zones; public atrium embedded in office shell embedded in envelope, fully within the long-axis unit volume.

sentences.name: unit_expand_expand_la
sentences.rationale: Combination 08: two sequential expansions applied to the full-unit long-axis seed; the outer shell buffers east noise while the expanded inner volume provides usable depth.

sentences.name: unit_intersect_split_la
sentences.rationale: Combination 12: intersection then split cuts the compound form into two discreet wings sharing a common structural bay; east entry thread connects them on the ground floor.

sentences.name: unit_bend_branch_la
sentences.rationale: Combination 16: the body bends in section and a branch springs from the elbow eastward; produces a hooked form, primary office bar bent south-to-west with a public arm east.

sentences.name: unit_notch_twist_la
sentences.rationale: Combination 20: a corner notch on the northeast edge combined with a mild twist in the vertical gives a subtly torqued form with a carved re-entrant corner that softens the north-east sunlight boundary.

sentences.name: unit_taper_array_short
sentences.rationale: Full-unit short-axis orientation tapers the narrow east face and arrays the cross-section; the result reads as a tapering slab perpendicular to the road with repetitive fins on the east facade.

sentences.name: unit_split_join_short
sentences.rationale: Short-axis full unit split transversely and rejoined offset north-south, producing a pinched waist elevation on the east road face with a wider base and narrower top.

sentences.name: unit_inflate_pack_short
sentences.rationale: Short-axis full unit inflated and packed; inflating the cross-section outward creates a barrel-vault profile perpendicular to the east road, referencing civic hall typology with compact plan.

sentences.name: unit_skew_reflect_pack_short
sentences.rationale: Short-axis full unit skewed and reflected, packing a mirrored pair across the parcel north-south axis. The east facades of both pieces step outward symmetrically, expressing a gateway to the parcel.

sentences.name: unit_bend_stack_short
sentences.rationale: Bent and stacked short-axis full unit; the bend arches the cross-section so upper floors vault over the east entry. Stacking keeps the height within 5 storeys while covering more GFA longitudinally.

sentences.name: unit_branch_short
sentences.rationale: Single branch from a short-axis full-unit; the branch extends east toward the road as a projecting public lobby, leaving the main body oriented north-south with south courtyard access.

sentences.name: unit_extrude_short
sentences.rationale: Simple short-axis extrusion of the full-unit cell, slab-on-grade to 5 storeys; depth perpendicular to east road maximises daylight penetration and natural ventilation through the office floors.

sentences.name: unit_intersect_short
sentences.rationale: Two short-axis full-unit volumes intersected diagonally; the intersection zone is removed to create two interlocked prisms with an open slot that draws east-facing light into the west interior.

sentences.name: unit_offset_short
sentences.rationale: Short-axis full unit with east skin offset outward; the offset face becomes a single-skin sunscreen layer in front of the primary glazed facade, usable as a planted trellis for the public office.

sentences.name: unit_shift_short
sentences.rationale: Upper storeys of the short-axis full unit shifted eastward, forming a jetty over the public pavement; the shift generates a dramatic east overhang reading as a civic gesture on the road.

sentences.name: unit_embed_branch_short
sentences.rationale: Case 61 short-axis: internal volume embedded creates an occupied void then a branch springs east as a covered entry link to the road; the void doubles as a light well within the deep plan.

sentences.name: unit_expand_nest_short
sentences.rationale: Case 63 short-axis: expanded outer shell nests the primary volume inside; the gap between shells is a public circulation gallery open on the south, with office rooms in the nested core.

sentences.name: unit_bend_shift_short
sentences.rationale: Case 65 short-axis: the bar bends and the top section shifts west, creating an arched plan with a displaced crown; the west side becomes a recessed loggia under the cantilevered upper floor.

sentences.name: unit_lift_carve_short
sentences.rationale: Case 67 short-axis: lift exposes the ground plane on the north and carving removes a wedge from the south corner; creates a column-free passage under the lifted office floor facing the road.

sentences.name: unit_overlap_rotate_short
sentences.rationale: Case 69 short-axis: a rotated second volume overlaps the primary; their shared edge becomes the structural spine, with a splayed eastern mouth opening toward the road.

sentences.name: unit_embed_embed_short
sentences.rationale: Combination 04 short-axis: double-embedded volumes in a short-axis seed produce layered occupancy zones, reading as a tripartite civic interior from the east.

sentences.name: unit_expand_expand_short
sentences.rationale: Combination 08 short-axis: two expansions on the short unit grow successive skins outward; the west side becomes a thick buffer; east road facade is glazed.

sentences.name: unit_intersect_split_short
sentences.rationale: Combination 12 short-axis: intersection removes overlap then split divides the remainder into north and south wings connected at the east entry core.

sentences.name: unit_bend_branch_short
sentences.rationale: Combination 16 short-axis: bend in plan arcs the bar and then a branch projects south from the bend apex; the south arm opens to a ground-level public plaza between building and street.

sentences.name: unit_notch_twist_short
sentences.rationale: Combination 20 short-axis: notch cuts the southeast corner, twist rotates the profile gradually, yielding a tapered chamfered tower-like form with active east-facing stepped terraces.

sentences.name: unit_rotate_array_stack_vert
sentences.rationale: Full-unit vertical orientation: successive floors rotated slightly and stacked, creating a helical tower profile; each plate aligns with a slightly different heading, the east face spiraling in a readable rhythm.

sentences.name: unit_pinch_join_array_vert
sentences.rationale: Full-unit vertical: two copies pinched at mid-height, joined and arrayed vertically. The pinch creates a hourglass waist and the array repeats the pinched section through height, a striated tower.

sentences.name: unit_split_join_vert
sentences.rationale: Full-unit vertical split horizontally at mid-height then rejoined offset east; the upper half cantilevers east over the lower, creating a dramatic public overhang and sheltered entry level.

sentences.name: unit_inflate_pack_vert
sentences.rationale: Full-unit vertical inflated at the center and packed tight within the legal envelope; the inflated belly pushes east toward the road maximising usable floor-plate depth at mid-height.

sentences.name: unit_expand_reflect_vert
sentences.rationale: Full-unit vertical: expanded form reflected about its horizontal mid-plane; the reflection creates a symmetric diamond section, visible from the east as a pinched-waist building.

sentences.name: unit_branch_vert
sentences.rationale: Full-unit vertical with a branch projecting east at mid-height, forming a T-section in elevation; the branch is a public balcony-terrace for the civic office at the third floor, cantilever toward the road.

sentences.name: unit_extrude_vert
sentences.rationale: Vertical extrusion of the full-unit cell straight up to 5 storeys; compact tower footprint within the parcel, the east face flush with the property line road-setback.

sentences.name: unit_intersect_vert
sentences.rationale: Full-unit vertical intersect: two tower prisms cross-intersected diagonally, leaving a coupled pair; 4 storeys fits the reduced net floor area within ground coverage limit.

sentences.name: unit_offset_vert
sentences.rationale: Full-unit vertical with offset applied on the east face, creating a projecting horizontal ledge per floor as a brise-soleil and GFA donor facing the public road.

sentences.name: unit_shift_vert
sentences.rationale: Full-unit vertical with progressive east shift per floor; creates a leaning silhouette toward the road that overhangs the pavement entry at top floors, a civic inclined tower.

sentences.name: unit_carve_offset_vert
sentences.rationale: Case 60 vertical: carve removes a wedge from the northeast corner, offset thickens the south skin; the carved corner reduces shadow on the north while the south offset adds depth.

sentences.name: unit_embed_overlap_vert
sentences.rationale: Case 62 vertical: inner volume embedded and then a second volume overlaps from the east; the overlapping zone creates a double-layered east entry facade with the embedded core visible through the glass overlap.

sentences.name: unit_overlap_expand_vert
sentences.rationale: Case 64 vertical: overlapping volume expanded outward; the expanded overlap becomes a thick east bay that reads as a projecting civic tower element from the road.

sentences.name: unit_embed_taper_vert
sentences.rationale: Case 66 vertical: embed hollows the core and taper narrows the upper half; the tapered top with embedded void creates an hourglass crown, reducing the north massing close to the sunlight boundary.

sentences.name: unit_lift_extrude_vert
sentences.rationale: Case 68 vertical: ground floor lifted on supports, remaining volume extruded straight up; the lifted ground creates a public arcade under the office mass facing the east road.

sentences.name: unit_inscribe_inscribe_vert
sentences.rationale: Combination 01 vertical: inscribed form within inscribed form, two concentric prisms turned 45 degrees; octagon-in-square section tower with the east diagonal aligning with the access direction.

sentences.name: unit_taper_taper_vert
sentences.rationale: Combination 05 vertical: double taper narrows top and bottom with a wider middle, producing a lens-like tower section; south facing opens the widest zone toward sunlight.

sentences.name: unit_shift_shift_vert
sentences.rationale: Combination 09 vertical: two successive shifts, east at low level and west at high level, create a Z-section tower leaning into and away from the road; kinetic silhouette from the east pavement.

sentences.name: unit_split_embed_vert
sentences.rationale: Combination 13 vertical: tower split vertically and an embedded bridge volume reinserted between the halves; the split creates two slender shafts with an embedded link at upper mid-level.

sentences.name: unit_branch_expand_vert
sentences.rationale: Combination 17 vertical: branch projects east from the tower at upper level then that arm is expanded outward; creates a mushroom canopy on the east face at the top two floors, sheltering the entry below.

sentences.name: sixteenth_rotate_array_stack_la
sentences.rationale: Thin 1/16 cell long-axis: rotated, arrayed and stacked to assemble a fine-grain facade screen; each rotated cell creates a louvered bay on the east road front.

sentences.name: sixteenth_pinch_join_array_la
sentences.rationale: Thin 1/16 cell long-axis: pinched at mid-height, joined and arrayed to form a waisted repetitive profile; the array reads as a rhythmic structural grid east to west.

sentences.name: sixteenth_branch_pack_stack_la
sentences.rationale: Thin 1/16 cell long-axis: branched, packed and stacked into a compact cluster; multiple thin branches read as a corded bundle from the east, suggesting a structural lattice facade.

sentences.name: sixteenth_inflate_pack_la
sentences.rationale: Thin 1/16 long-axis cell inflated then packed; inflation gives a bulbous cross-section that packs tightly east-west, yielding continuous curved floor plates between structure and skin.

sentences.name: sixteenth_taper_array_short
sentences.rationale: Thin 1/16 short-axis bar tapered and arrayed; the taper narrows each unit toward the north and the array assembles a comb-like plan reading as a fine-grain public campus from above.

sentences.name: sixteenth_pinch_join_array_short
sentences.rationale: Thin 1/16 short-axis: pinched and joined then arrayed laterally; produces a picket-fence silhouette of waisted thin slabs from the south, with the east road reading them edge-on.

sentences.name: sixteenth_branch_pack_stack_short
sentences.rationale: Thin 1/16 short-axis: branch then pack then stack; thin cells branch perpendicular then pack east-west into a dense laminar stack, creating a ribbed plan structure with air slots between each rib.

sentences.name: sixteenth_skew_reflect_pack_short
sentences.rationale: Thin 1/16 short-axis: skewed and reflected then packed; the reflected pair creates a V-plan in section facing east, its valley opening toward the road as a naturally ventilated atrium in section.

sentences.name: sixteenth_taper_array_vert
sentences.rationale: Thin 1/16 vertical: tapered and arrayed upward; a thin slab tapers as it rises, arrayed to form multiple progressively thinner columns, a fragmented tower bundle facing east.

sentences.name: sixteenth_split_join_vert
sentences.rationale: Thin 1/16 vertical: split at mid-height and joined offset; the upper half cantilevers south, with the east face remaining plumb and the south offset creating a dramatic overhang toward sunlight.

sentences.name: sixteenth_branch_pack_stack_vert
sentences.rationale: Thin 1/16 vertical: branch then pack then stack; a primary thin shaft branches out a spine at multiple levels, packing the branches tightly into the vertical envelope, a layered vertical campus.

sentences.name: sixteenth_skew_reflect_pack_vert
sentences.rationale: Thin 1/16 vertical: skewed and reflected then packed; the reflected skewed pair forms a cross-leaning brace silhouette from east, structurally expressive and narrowing at north.

sentences.name: half_rotate_array_stack_la
sentences.rationale: Half-unit long-axis: floors rotated and stacked; the rotation per storey produces a gentle twist visible on the east facade, giving the office bar a dynamic street presence without extreme structural complexity.

sentences.name: half_taper_array_la
sentences.rationale: Half-unit long-axis: tapered and arrayed; the taper reduces the bar width toward the north and the array places two tapered bars side by side, producing a V-plan pair converging north.

sentences.name: half_split_join_la
sentences.rationale: Half-unit long-axis split and rejoined with an east-west offset; the two halves slide apart laterally, opening a central corridor-void aligned north-south that draws breezes through the plan.

sentences.name: half_inflate_pack_la
sentences.rationale: Half-unit long-axis inflated and packed; the inflated cross-section bulges northward into the sunlight setback zone at lower floors where still permitted, producing a profile that conforms to the sloped legal boundary.

sentences.name: half_rotate_array_stack_short
sentences.rationale: Half-unit short-axis rotated per storey and stacked; each floor is a half-unit section turned slightly, yielding a kinked fin wall reading from east as a gently pinwheeling plane.

sentences.name: half_pinch_join_array_short
sentences.rationale: Half-unit short-axis pinched, joined and arrayed; produces a comb of pinched slab elements south-facing, each pinch creating a structural neck that visually separates bays.

sentences.name: half_split_join_short
sentences.rationale: Half-unit short-axis split and rejoined offset; the upper half slides east relative to the lower, creating a stepped section perpendicular to the road, the east face becomes a stair of protruding floor edges.

sentences.name: half_inflate_pack_short
sentences.rationale: Half-unit short-axis inflated and packed; the inflated bar swells laterally to fill the parcel width while the east face curves gently convex toward the road.

sentences.name: half_rotate_array_stack_vert
sentences.rationale: Half-unit vertical rotated per floor and stacked; the rotating half-plates create a helical slot tower; eastern slot opens progressively as the building rises, reducing bulk at the top near the north sunlight zone.

sentences.name: half_pinch_join_array_vert
sentences.rationale: Half-unit vertical pinched, joined and arrayed vertically; the array creates a tower of pinched half-unit disks stacked alternately, forming an undulating exterior surface facing south.

sentences.name: half_branch_pack_stack_vert
sentences.rationale: Half-unit vertical branched, packed and stacked; the branch extends the half-unit into horizontal arms at different heights, packed tightly within the volume, a cluster tower of interlocking half-prisms.

sentences.name: half_inflate_pack_vert
sentences.rationale: Half-unit vertical inflated and packed; the inflated half-unit swells the east face outward, creating a convex east skin on the tower while packing the structure within the legal volume.

sentences.name: quarter_taper_array_la
sentences.rationale: Quarter-unit long-axis tapered and arrayed; four tapered quarter-bars are arrayed north-south to form a comb plan, each bar tapering toward the north following the sunlight setback gradient.

sentences.name: quarter_pinch_join_array_la
sentences.rationale: Quarter-unit long-axis pinched at mid-height, joined and arrayed; the result is a waisted bar array in plan south of the parcel center, their joints forming a structural colonnade facing south.

sentences.name: quarter_branch_pack_stack_la
sentences.rationale: Quarter-unit long-axis branched, packed and stacked; slender quarter-unit bars branch outward, pack tightly, and stack five storeys into a lattice-like figure oriented east-west across the parcel.

sentences.name: quarter_skew_reflect_pack_la
sentences.rationale: Quarter-unit long-axis skewed and reflected then packed; the reflected oblique pair creates a chevron plan, its apex pointing east toward the road like a civic prow.

sentences.name: quarter_taper_array_short
sentences.rationale: Quarter-unit short-axis tapered and arrayed; the narrow bars taper in the east-west direction and are arrayed north-south, forming a graduated screen plan between east road and west interior.

sentences.name: quarter_split_join_short
sentences.rationale: Quarter-unit short-axis split and rejoined with a south offset; the two quarter-unit pieces separate at mid-height and the upper half moves south, creating a south-cantilevering slab over the lower.

sentences.name: quarter_branch_pack_stack_short
sentences.rationale: Quarter-unit short-axis branched, packed and stacked; compact quarter bars branch south, pack east-west and stack; the east-west orientation maximises depth from road to interior for office planning.

sentences.name: quarter_skew_reflect_pack_short
sentences.rationale: Quarter-unit short-axis skewed and reflected then packed; the reflected skewed quarter-units assemble into an X-brace plan pattern reading from the east as an abstract structural diagram.

sentences.name: quarter_expand_vert
sentences.rationale: Quarter-unit vertical expanded uniformly; a slender quarter-unit prism grows outward to fill the legal footprint, with the east face remaining on the road alignment and all other sides expanding to coverage.

sentences.name: quarter_inscribe_vert
sentences.rationale: Quarter-unit vertical inscribed in a larger volume; the inscribed prism is rotated 30 degrees to the legal envelope, creating a diagonal grain office tower with an oblique east face catching road light at an angle.

sentences.name: quarter_nest_vert
sentences.rationale: Quarter-unit vertical nested; one quarter-prism nested inside a second slightly larger prism, a service core tower inside a structural sleeve, the gap between them being a circulation zone on all four sides.

sentences.name: quarter_rotate_vert
sentences.rationale: Quarter-unit vertical rotated at each storey; each floor turns 6 degrees so over 5 floors the top is 30 degrees off the base heading, creating a clearly spiralling tower.

sentences.name: eighth_rotate_array_stack_la
sentences.rationale: Eighth-unit long-axis rotated, arrayed and stacked; very thin long cells rotated slightly and tiled yield a basket-weave facade pattern on the east, each rotated layer interlocking with the next.

sentences.name: eighth_pinch_join_array_la
sentences.rationale: Eighth-unit long-axis pinched, joined and arrayed; a waisted thin slab array south-facing produces a fine-grain ribbed elevation with strong shadow lines from the pinch points.

sentences.name: eighth_split_join_la
sentences.rationale: Eighth-unit long-axis split and rejoined with offset; the split thin bar offsets north and south to create a pinched Y plan at the east entry, with the two arms flanking the public entrance.

sentences.name: eighth_inflate_pack_la
sentences.rationale: Eighth-unit long-axis inflated and packed; inflated thin slabs are packed tightly east-west, each with a rounded cross-section creating a continuous corrugated surface facing east.

sentences.name: eighth_rotate_array_stack_short
sentences.rationale: Eighth-unit short-axis rotated and stacked; very thin cross-sections rotated per floor give a stacked-card tower effect; the east face shows each rotated card edge as a projecting slab.

sentences.name: eighth_pinch_join_array_short
sentences.rationale: Eighth-unit short-axis pinched, joined and arrayed; waisted thin short bars are joined at their necks and arrayed laterally, producing a south-elevation colonnade of pinched structural ribs.

sentences.name: eighth_branch_pack_stack_short
sentences.rationale: Eighth-unit short-axis branched, packed and stacked; the micro-scale branches assemble into a dense lattice plan, each branch packing tightly and the stack rising five floors as a crystalline cluster.

sentences.name: eighth_skew_reflect_pack_short
sentences.rationale: Eighth-unit short-axis skewed and reflected then packed; micro-parallelogram cells mirrored and packed form a herringbone plan whose sharp east edge aligns with the road and west end fans apart.

sentences.name: eighth_bend_vert
sentences.rationale: Eighth-unit vertical bent; the slender vertical prism bends east at mid-height, forming an arched column that leans toward the road, a structural archway readable from the east pavement.

sentences.name: eighth_extract_vert
sentences.rationale: Eighth-unit vertical with extraction: an interior segment extracted outward on the south face, producing a projecting bay window element repeated at each floor level on the south elevation.

sentences.name: eighth_interlock_vert
sentences.rationale: Eighth-unit vertical interlocked: two eighth-unit prisms interlocked at an angle, forming an X-brace tower from the east; the interlocking geometry provides lateral stability while generating complex section.

sentences.name: eighth_notch_vert
sentences.rationale: Eighth-unit vertical with notch; a corner notch is cut from the northeast edge of the thin tower at upper floors, responding to the sunlight setback by chamfering the north-east corner above 9 m.

sentences.name: threeeighths_taper_array_la
sentences.rationale: Three-eighths L-unit long-axis tapered and arrayed; the L-shape tapers its shorter arm and the array places two L-shapes back-to-back, creating a U-plan courtyard open to the east road.

sentences.name: threeeighths_split_join_la
sentences.rationale: Three-eighths L-unit long-axis split and joined offset; the L is split along its spine and the halves staggered south and north, creating a Z-L plan with a diagonal junction reading from the south.

sentences.name: threeeighths_inflate_pack_la
sentences.rationale: Three-eighths L-unit long-axis inflated and packed; the inflated L fills the envelope at ground and the packing snaps it to the parcel edges, yielding a fatter L plan with rounded interior corners.

sentences.name: threeeighths_bend_la
sentences.rationale: Three-eighths L-unit long-axis bent; the L-form bends its long arm into a gentle curve, creating a crescent plan with the concave side facing east toward the road, a civic curved courtyard facade.

sentences.name: threeeighths_rotate_array_stack_short
sentences.rationale: Three-eighths L-unit short-axis rotated, arrayed and stacked; the L-units rotate per floor and the array plus stack build a spiral staircase of L-section floors creating a twisting open staircase silhouette.

sentences.name: threeeighths_taper_array_short
sentences.rationale: Three-eighths L-unit short-axis tapered and arrayed; two tapered L-units arrayed side by side produce a stepped W-plan when viewed from the south, each arm narrowing independently toward the north.

sentences.name: threeeighths_split_join_short
sentences.rationale: Three-eighths L-unit short-axis split and rejoined; the L is split at the re-entrant corner and rejoined with a horizontal offset, producing a step-plan with two overlapping L-fragments connected by a bridge.

sentences.name: threeeighths_inflate_pack_short
sentences.rationale: Three-eighths L-unit short-axis inflated and packed; inflating the L rounds its interior corner, and packing snaps the swollen form to the parcel; the east face becomes a convex arc meeting the road.

sentences.name: threeeighths_branch_vert
sentences.rationale: Three-eighths L-unit vertical with branch; the vertical L-tower branches east at the fourth floor, extending a public roof terrace toward the road; the L-section means the branch anchors to the tower corner.

sentences.name: threeeighths_extrude_vert
sentences.rationale: Three-eighths L-unit vertical extruded straight; the L-section tower with one arm facing east and one arm facing south creates a corner building addressing both the road and a south public space simultaneously.

sentences.name: threeeighths_intersect_vert
sentences.rationale: Three-eighths L-unit vertical intersected with a second L rotated 90 degrees; the intersection creates a cruciform notched tower with four re-entrant corners, maximising perimeter and daylight access to offices.

sentences.name: threeeighths_offset_vert
sentences.rationale: Three-eighths L-unit vertical with offset on the outer east face; the offset adds a screen layer on the east arm of the L, deepening the public facade and providing solar control for the office floors behind.
